message.content: In one of the conversations, LiHua mentions a particularly memorable moment from the game "Black Myth: Wukong". Specifically, he talks about a battle scene where he had to outsmart a giant enemy, which turned out to be an "amazing battle scene where I had to outsmart a giant enemy! The strategy involved was so satisfying, and the graphics made it even more epic." LiHua further elaborates that "Oh, I had this amazing battle scene where I had to outsmart a giant enemy! The strategy involved was so satisfying, and the graphics made it even more epic. Have you come across any memorable moments during your playthroughs?" This indicates that LiHua found the battle involving a giant enemy to be both strategic and visually captivating.
